title: Bach, "Little" Fugue in G minor, Organ
summary: Stephen Malinowski performs Bach's Little Fugue in G minor on organ, accompanied by an animated graphical score. Pedalboard playing carries one of the melodic lines.
why: Linked as the original organ version of the piece, with a visual score that makes the fugue easy to follow.

quote.text: Compare the Little Organ Fugue as originally intended
